query:
INSERT INTO voice_user_profiles (user_id, name, active, updated_at, active_updated_at)
            VALUES ($1, '', $2, to_timestamp(0), $3)
            ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE
                SET active = EXCLUDED.active, active_updated_at = EXCLUDED.active_updated_at
                WHERE voice_user_profiles.active_updated_at <= EXCLUDED.active_updated_at
